videos.desc: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.

A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.

In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.

A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.

A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.

A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.

A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.

A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.

In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

A narrow, rain-wet street at night lit by neon lotus-flower signs in pink and yellow. Close up, a young man in a mustard shirt leans out of his three-wheeled taxi, shouting angrily and shaking his raised fist. The view pulls back and shows a young woman in a blue top and white trousers riding past on a mint-green bicycle with a basket, looking straight ahead and ignoring him. Street food stalls glow under strip lights behind her and the neon colours reflect in the wet road.

An old street at dusk after rain, lined with yellow colonial houses with green shutters, iron balconies and hanging flowers. A traffic light on a pole glows a steady, warm amber colour. Below it a young woman in a cream helmet, white blouse, navy skirt and white trainers sits on a cream scooter, stopped at the crossing, and looks up at the light with a smile as the wind moves her hair. The amber glow reflects as a long streak on the wet road, and bicycles are parked by a shop front.

In a steep, narrow cobbled alley between old stone houses with flower pots, shutters and washing hung between the windows, a small, round, shiny red vintage car with chrome bumpers drives slowly down the stone steps towards the camera as red petals float down. A laughing young woman leans out of the passenger window, then sits back inside, and she and the driver laugh behind the windscreen. A young man with a bicycle and an old woman with a basket of bread watch from doorways.

Inside a long black luxury car on a rainy night in a city, a young female chauffeur in a black peaked cap, black jacket and leather gloves drives calmly, looking ahead. Behind her a clear glass wall divides the car, and in the back seat a laughing bride in a lace wedding dress and a young woman in a pink dress hit each other with pillows, filling the back with flying white feathers. City lights blur through the wet windows.

At a floodlit race track at night a dark blue sports car stops hard at the edge of the track, its front brake disc glowing bright orange behind the black wheel spokes, with sparks spraying from under the car. Another car streaks past as a red blur. The blue car then swings round towards the camera, its tyres smoking heavily, and slides sideways along the red and white kerb with the orange brakes still glowing. A stack of old tyres lies in the foreground, and a marshal post stands by a green light.

Beside a desert highway with red rock cliffs in the distance, a worn-out pale blue station wagon with two rusty orange doors and bags roped onto its roof rack stands on the gravel shoulder, with white steam pouring from its open bonnet. A wing mirror falls off onto the ground. A young man in a red T-shirt and dirty jeans throws up a hand, kicks the car door, waves his cap and laughs up at the sky. A spare tyre and a fuel can lie in front, and a lorry approaches on the road.

On a dusty farm track between sunflower fields on a sunny day, a young woman with a long black ponytail, a brown leather jacket, a white top and jeans sits on the bench of a wooden cart with big spoked wheels, piled high with watermelons. She catches a watermelon that she has tossed into the air and holds it on her lap while a chestnut horse pulls the cart forward. A basket of sunflowers hangs on the side, a straw hat lies on the seat, a dog trots behind, and farm workers wave near a red-roofed farmhouse.

In a narrow cobbled lane of brick houses on a wet autumn day, an old red sports car is parked by the wall, almost completely hidden under a fitted grey fabric cover that is soaked with rain. The cover has slipped off at the front corner, showing a red wing and a round chrome headlight. A gust lifts the front of the cover, showing the chrome grille and number plate, then it drops back into place. Water drips onto the cobbles and yellow leaves lie on the car and the ground.

On a wide sandy beach on a bright, hazy day, a young woman with a blond braid in black cycling clothes leans a black fat-tyre bike into a sharp turn on the wet sand, the back wheel spraying sand and leaving a curved track. She passes a jellyfish lying on the sand and rides away from the camera along the curving tracks. Kitesurfers ride the waves under colourful kites, a man stands with a dog near the water, and people walk near the dunes.

Inside a dim old railway depot. A green diesel locomotive stands over an inspection pit with its front panels opened wide, showing a large grey engine inside. Thick black smoke pours from its roof into shafts of light from the high windows and slowly turns grey, while pigeons fly up through the beams and clouds of white smoke burst out from under the locomotive. Brick walls and another locomotive surround it. On the floor lie a coiled hose, a rag and a row of spanners, and gas cylinders stand on a trolley.

On a gravel lane at a country cottage in golden evening light, a young man in a navy suit and red bow tie drives an old red tractor with a big bunch of sunflowers tied to the side towards the front door. As he comes closer he raises his straw boater hat, and dust rises behind the wheels. A young woman in a flowered dress stands on the doorstep with her hands over her mouth and then laughs, while an older woman watches from an upstairs window. Roses cover the walls and hay bales lie in the fields.

At a desert gas station at sunset, a huge red dust storm rolls in behind the lit canopy. A young attendant in an orange shirt and dark apron stands at a fuel pump beside a mud-covered rally car and points at the queue of cars with headlights on waiting on the dirt road. Two drivers in racing suits climb out of the car, carry their white helmets and walk towards the viewer. A dry tumbleweed lies on the concrete forecourt.

A bearded man in a dark three-piece suit and red tie rides a tall unicycle down the traffic lane of a busy city bridge on a sunny morning, beside the metal barrier. He holds a paper coffee cup in one gloved hand and a brown leather briefcase in the other, and his tie flies over his shoulder in the wind. A red double-decker bus, a black car and a yellow taxi move in the traffic behind him, with tall towers beyond. He sips his coffee as he rides, and a smiling cyclist follows him.

A smiling young woman in a long silver satin dress climbs barefoot over a high old stone wall covered in ivy at an evening garden party, holding the top with one hand, her silver high-heeled sandals in her teeth. She swings her leg over, takes the sandals in her hand and sits on top of the wall, laughing and touching her hair. Below, on the lawn in front of a large country house, guests in black suits and dark dresses stand by a white tent and watch her as the sun sets behind the trees.

A dark green vintage sports car with round headlights on stands at the grassy side of a narrow country lane on a grey rainy day, with tall green hedges and a church spire in the distance. A smiling young man in a navy jumper holds the passenger door open while a laughing young woman with long dark hair climbs into the passenger seat. He then leans in towards her and she smiles out at him from the car. Pink flower petals and a green ribbon lie on the wet grass and road.

On a narrow mountain road on a sunny summer day, a rusty old flatbed truck carries a huge, top-heavy stack of hay bales tied with rope, piled far higher and wider than the truck itself. The truck stands at the edge of a low stone wall above a steep drop, and as the view moves around it, the load leans out over the drop and the front wheel hangs over the edge. A small stone roadside shrine with a wooden cross stands in the wildflowers in front, and green valleys and blue mountains stretch away behind.

Inside an old country bus on a warm, hazy day, a sign above the windscreen lists the stops. The aisle is crowded with passengers and their things: a white goat on a rope, a tall wooden wardrobe, a shaggy dog lying on the floor, a bicycle leaning on a seat, baskets of vegetables and a net of lemons. A man in overalls pats the goat, then walks up the aisle and stands by the wardrobe, wiping his face. Young people in shorts and T-shirts sit in the seats on both sides, and a young woman sits at the front.

A calm, glassy fjord at dawn seen from above. A young woman in a black wetsuit stands on a paddle board and paddles in a wide curve around a large humpback whale lying at the surface right next to her, while its misty spout rises into the air. Further out another whale lifts its tail above the water, and a small boat with people in orange jackets watches. Pieces of floating ice drift on the water and snowy mountains are reflected in the still surface.

Sea kayaking in front of a glacier under a grey sky. A young man in a red helmet, a yellow jacket and a life vest faces the camera and paddles hard away from the glacier in a white sea kayak, his face strained, as a huge wall of blue ice breaks off behind him and crashes into the sea in a cloud of spray. Other kayakers in bright jackets sit in their kayaks further back, chunks of ice float on the choppy grey sea around him and seabirds circle overhead.

Dusk at a narrow stone canal lock. A huge white cruise ship eases slowly forward into the lock, its bow only just fitting between the walls and pressing big black fenders against the sides while water churns at the hull. Crowds on the quay wave and take photos, workers in high-visibility jackets walk along the edge, passengers line the lit decks and strings of lights run up to the mast. A small stone lock-keeper's house with a lit window stands by the dark water.

A harbour on a foggy blue morning. A young woman in navy work overalls, gloves, boots and a knitted hat throws her whole weight against a long iron lever on the cobbled quay and pulls it down from upright to flat, smiling. The two halves of an old wooden drawbridge stand raised in the air, and a tall sailing ship slides through the gap. Behind a red and white barrier, cyclists, a bus, cars and people in hi-vis vests wait under lit street lamps.

On a canal towpath on a misty morning, with an old brick bridge arching over the water, a laughing young man in a checked flannel shirt, a grey hoodie, work trousers and boots leans forward and hauls a green narrowboat along the bank with a thick rope over his shoulder. The boat moves slowly forward. Three young men in winter jackets sit on the boat roof, one raising a mug and cheering. A grey heron stands on the far bank, and a coil of rope and an iron winch lie on the path.

A 3D-animated car repair garage. A big brown bear in blue overalls stands on his hind legs and fits the front wheel onto a shiny red sports car raised on a lift, then lets go and stands back. A raccoon in an orange overall and red cap lies on a wheeled creeper on the floor holding a spanner, then gets up and stands on the creeper. Red tool chests, spare tyres on a wall rack and an air hose fill the workshop, and autumn leaves blow in through the open roller door.

A fairground wall-of-death show at night. A rider in a helmet, goggles and a grey vest races a motorbike sideways round and round the inside of a huge round wooden drum, its headlight shining, smoke and dark tyre marks circling the boards. Above the rim young spectators cheer with raised fists while a man in a flat cap waves a red flag. The view then moves behind the spectators, who clap with raised hands as the rider keeps circling below. Strings of light bulbs and a big wheel glow in the dark.

The front seat of a red roller coaster car as it goes over the top of a steep drop, with the track plunging down ahead. A young woman in a pink cap and white T-shirt stretches her arms straight out in front of her and leans towards the drop, screaming with joy, then turns to the camera with a huge smile as the car starts down. The rider in the seat behind her, seen only by his arms and green T-shirt, grips the metal lap bar. Far below lie an amusement park with a Ferris wheel, colourful rides, a lake and trees under a bright blue sky.

A huge car park full of cars on a sunny day. A giant blue monster truck with flame decals stands right on top of two small cars in their marked spaces, its enormous tyres crushing a red car and a white car and cracking their windscreens. As the view pulls back, a young man in a white T-shirt stands on the truck's bonnet with both arms raised in triumph. Below, a young woman in a burgundy top stands with her arms crossed looking annoyed, and a man holds his head in shock. Broken glass lies on the ground.

A sunny cobbled street in an old town with pastel houses and a striped awning. A young woman in a white helmet, black leather jacket and red top rides a classic motorbike up the street and lifts it onto its back wheel as she passes the café. The café guests get out of the way: a young woman in a yellow top leans far back in her chair with her arm up, others press against the wall, and a waiter in a black apron flattens himself in the doorway. A worker in an orange vest stands at the far end.

A dark wooden house stands in deep snow on a clear winter day, with icicles hanging from the roof. A young woman in a red knitted hat, navy jacket and black trousers digs with a snow shovel, cutting a narrow path through snow as high as her waist along the house. A husky runs along the cleared path behind her and past her. She throws a shovel of snow high over the wall. Inside, an older man and woman watch through the big glass window.
